One of my mom's friends is constantly making excessive minnats (for example, I will pray 200 salat-ut-tasbeeh, or finish the quran 50 times if such and such a thing happens). After the her duaa is accepted and the event happens she is unable to fulfill her minnat and almost forces my mom to help her fulfill it; for example, you read quran 40 times, I'll read it 10 times. Because the person is asking you to do a good deed you cannot refuse it, but it is also difficult to carry out the minnat within the period of time the friend gives. For this reason I was wondering if it is alright to tell the person to 1. not make such excessive minnats that you can't fulfill yourself 2. to pray or carry out the good deed before you make the duaa (since making minnat is sort of like playing with allah). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 15801 Country: India Title: "Can we make niyat like - if so so work is completed or my so so dua is accepted i will pray 2 raka salah as shukrana (Thank giving) or i will keep fast for this? " Question: "Can we make niyat like - if so so work is completed or my so so dua is accepted i will pray 2 raka salah as shukrana (Thank giving) or i will keep fast for this? " Answer ID: 15801 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1409/1125=L=1430) Yes, you can make intention in this way, but the rulings of nazr (vow) will be applied only when you say so verbally. In this case, performing salah or fasting sawm whatever will be meant will be necessary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
